title: Intel stock plunges, consumer sentiment high, gold & silver rally
text: Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including US consumer sentiment hitting a five-month high, Intel (INTC) stock's nosedive, and gold (GC=F) and silver's (SI=F) record-setting weekly performance. Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
